description:
An embedded analytical engine for the JVM, built on DuckDB. Java objects become typed
        columns and are asked questions in SQL - aggregates, pivots, joins - without being rebuilt.
        Guarded read-only execution for SQL you did not write, catalog introspection, Java collections
        queried as tables, Java functions in SQL, nested types, vector search, and sparse measures with
        history. Includes a CQEngine persistence plugin built on the same storage.
